message.content:
The tests failed because of a typo in the unit table in `duration.go`. The `'m'` (minutes) unit was mapped to `time.Second` instead of `time.Minute`. So `45m` parsed as 45 seconds, and `1h30m` parsed as 1h0m30s.

I changed that entry to `'m': time.Minute`. The tests now pass.
